label: Homonym site name (same county)
description: Two or more rows in the same county share an identical normalized project_name but represent distinct programs (different organization_name).
detection_rule: Group by (county, .normalize_name(project_name)); flag groups where n_distinct(organization_name) > 1
policy: Auto-fuzzy match will not disambiguate — route to bucket D and flag for analyst review.

label: Homonym site name (different county)
description: Same normalized project_name appears in two or more counties.
policy: Acceptable when programs genuinely share a name; included so reconciliation does not cross-match by name alone.

label: Missing required column
description: Source file lacks one or more codebook-required columns for its kind.

label: Capacity zero or NA
description: Capacity sheet row reports capacity <= 0 or NA where enrollment > 0.
policy: Block validation — likely data entry error.

label: Enrollment exceeds capacity
description: Capacity sheet row where enrollment > capacity.
policy: Warn — possibly over-enrollment by ADECE policy exception; flag for review.

label: Waitlist greater than 3x capacity
description: Suspiciously large waitlist relative to capacity.
policy: Warn — likely data entry error or extreme demand site.

label: Zero-capacity classroom in renewal/new
description: Renewal or new application reports a draft_award > 0 but capacity = 0 in linked capacity row.
detection_rule: draft_award > 0 AND linked capacity row's capacity = 0
policy: Warn — inconsistency between sheets; requires reconciliation review.

label: Duplicate site_code different organization
description: Same site_code appears in multiple cycles linked to different organization_name.
detection_rule: Group panel by site_code; flag if n_distinct(organization_name) > 1 across years
policy: Warn — likely program ownership change or site_code reuse.

label: Renewal in new sheet (misclassified)
description: Row in new_apps sheet exactly matches a prior-cycle classroom by fuzzy_score >= 0.95.
detection_rule: new_apps row with reconcile bucket = C AND match_score >= 0.95
policy: Auto-route to bucket B-equivalent; log decision for analyst review.

label: New sheet but matches existing program
description: Row in new_apps sheet matches existing program at score in [0.85, 0.95).
detection_rule: new_apps row with reconcile bucket = C AND match_score in [0.85, 0.95)
policy: Auto bucket C — flag for analyst review (could be additional classroom at existing site).

label: Multiple sheets contradict
description: Same (organization_name, project_name) appears in BOTH renewals AND new_apps sheets.
detection_rule: Inner join of renewals and new_apps on (org_norm, project_norm, county_norm); flag any matches
policy: Block — data entry error in ADECE export.

label: Funding type not in canonical set
description: funding_type value not in alprek_applications_funding_types() codebook.
policy: Warn — codebook may need expansion (real cycle-1 finding: 'New Classroom Funding' etc.).

label: County not in Alabama set
description: county value not in 67 Alabama counties.
policy: Block — non-Alabama county is a real upstream bug.

label: Process name not in codebook
description: process_name value not in alprek_applications_status_codes() codebook (excluding noise).
policy: Warn — codebook may need expansion. The observed cycle-1 Round 2 variant is now codified; this case covers future unregistered variants.

label: Fully blank row
description: All non-data_source columns are NA or empty string.
detection_rule: rowSums(is.na or '' across data cols) == ncol-1
policy: Drop in clean step; log drop_fully_na.

label: Region format non-canonical
policy: Warn — likely typo or formatting variant.

label: Cross-field award mismatch
policy: Warn — ADECE calculation error or formula change.
